links.comparator_used: Same model (Qwen 2.5, Group D) without chain-of-thought prompting, compared before and after applying CoT
links.effect: Recall improved by 0.0621 ± 0.1474 (P < 0.05); hallucination rate rose by 0.0390 ± 0.1639 (P > 0.05, non-significant)
links.tradeoff: Potential increase in hallucination rate; the rise was not statistically significant
links.quote: Among enhancement strategies, chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improved Group D’s recall by 0.0621 ± 0.1474 (P < 0.05) but caused a non-significant increase in hallucination rate (0.0390 ± 0.1639, P > 0.05).

design_hint: long-text context grounding and chain-of-thought prompting
